findings.issue: The overview states the run-wide frontier cap as half of `maxIterations` with the seed inside it. The code makes that cap configurable and exempts the seed pass: `runCap = capValue(expansive.maxFrontierNodes, derivedCap)` (frontier-admit.cjs:258), so a config that sets `expansiveDepth.maxFrontierNodes` is not capped at half; when no config exists yet, which is the fan-out parent seed because it runs before any config is written, `derivedCap` falls back to `DEFAULT_MAX_FRONTIER_NODES` (10), not half (frontier-admit.cjs:53, 255-257); and admission skips the run-wide check entirely for the seeding pass (`if (!seeding && countLiveNodes(nodes) >= caps.maxFrontierNodes)`, frontier-admit.cjs:433), so a small explicit `--max-iterations` still admits every depth-1 seed past the cap. The shipped rule, stated in both packet catalogs and in the YAML config comment, is that the cap defaults to half of `maxIterations` and the depth-1 seed answers only to the root-children cap but counts toward the run cap.

fix.old: Admission caps the live frontier at half of `maxIterations`, and the seed counts toward that cap, so a defaulted budget is sized from the seed:
fix.new: Admission caps the live frontier at `expansiveDepth.maxFrontierNodes`, which defaults to half of `maxIterations` (10 when no config exists yet). The depth-1 seed answers only to the root-children cap but counts toward this one, so a defaulted budget is sized from the seed:

findings.issue: The Implementation table credits `fanout-run.cjs` only with passing `depthMode` to lineages and omits `runtime/scripts/fanout-merge.cjs`, which carries the other half of the fan-out partition the doc's own DR-073 and DRV-082 rows describe. Under expansive depth `fanout-run.cjs` records `summary.frontier_partition` (fanout-run.cjs:3838), and `fanout-merge.cjs` merges the lineage frontiers through `mergeResearchFrontier` (fanout-merge.cjs:771, 901, 1199) and emits `partitionGuard` naming the dealt nodes no lineage reported (fanout-merge.cjs:796), warning `frontier_partition_guard_failed` at fan-in (fanout-merge.cjs:1770-1771). Both packet catalogs list that file for this feature, and feature-catalog.md:55 says this doc holds the full implementation file listing.
